en_title: GTA 6 Global Release Times Confirmed: Here's How to Play Early Via the New Zealand Trick
cn_title: 《GTA6》全球发售时间已确认：如何通过新西兰技巧提前游玩
opus_summary: Rockstar确认《GTA6》将在各地当地时间11月19日零点解锁。XBOX玩家可通过更改主机地区提前游玩，PlayStation玩家则需创建新西兰账号并购买游戏。美国玩家使用该技巧可在美东时间11月18日早上7点左右游玩。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 will have a regional release, which means certain people can actually play it early thanks to what's called the New Zealand trick.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将分地区发售，这意味着有些人实际上可以借助所谓的「新西兰技巧」提前游玩。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games has confirmed that GTA 6 will become available at midnight local time, as the clock strikes November 19, meaning some parts of the world will get the game earlier than others. Xbox has a pretty well-known loophole known as the New Zealand trick, which allows you to play games a full day early with ease.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar已确认，《GTA6》将在当地时间午夜、时钟走到11月19日时解锁，这意味着世界上某些地区会比其他地区更早玩到游戏。XBOX有一个相当出名的漏洞，被称为「新西兰技巧」，可以让你轻松提前整整一天游玩游戏。

paragraphs.en: All you have to do is open your Xbox's settings menu, scroll down to System, and click on Language and location. Change the location tab to New Zealand and hit the "Restart Now" button on the right-hand side of this menu to reset your console. When you come back online, your console will be "in" New Zealand. As a result of this, make sure to buy GTA 6 before you change your console's location; otherwise, you will have to pay in New Zealand currency.
paragraphs.cn: 你只需打开XBOX的设置菜单，向下滚动到「系统」，然后点击「语言和位置」。将位置选项改为新西兰，再点击菜单右侧的「立即重启」按钮，重新启动主机。当你重新上线时，主机就会「位于」新西兰。因此，务必在更改主机位置之前购买《GTA6》；否则，你将不得不使用新西兰货币支付。

paragraphs.en: As for PlayStation, there is also a New Zealand trick, but it's not nearly as easy or convenient. You have to create a new account based in New Zealand and buy a copy for that account. You can then enable game sharing to give the game back to your main account, but you will likely need to play the game on the New Zealand profile until it unlocks for your regular account. So, it may be too much of a headache to even bother with this on PS5.
paragraphs.cn: 至于PlayStation，也有新西兰技巧，但远没有那么简单或方便。你必须创建一个地区为新西兰的新账户，并为该账户购买一份游戏。然后，你可以启用游戏共享，将游戏分享给主账户，但在游戏对你的常用账户解锁之前，你可能需要使用新西兰账户游玩。因此，在PS5上这么做可能太过麻烦，不值得费这个劲。

paragraphs.en: For those in the United States, using the New Zealand trick lets you play GTA 6 almost a full day early, at around 7am ET on November 18. This trick applies to those outside of the United States as well, but folks in the U.S. will arguably get the most mileage out of this, and playing early will help with the inevitable spoiler problem as GTA 6 goes live around the world ahead of you.
paragraphs.cn: 对于美国玩家来说，使用新西兰技巧可以让你几乎提前整整一天玩到《GTA6》，大约是在美国东部时间11月18日上午7点。这个技巧也适用于美国以外的玩家，但可以说美国玩家能从中获得最大的好处；随着《GTA6》在世界各地先于你所在的地区上线，剧透问题不可避免，提前游玩也有助于应对这一问题。

paragraphs.en: If you're avoiding the New Zealand trick, you'll need to wait until midnight local time.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你不打算使用新西兰技巧，就需要等到当地时间午夜。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 global release times on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S:
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》在PS5和XBOX Series X及S上的全球发售时间：

paragraphs.en: As is well documented, GTA 6 is not being released on-disc. Rockstar Games has released a 'code-in-box' version that is available now. So, all will have to download GTA 6, which weighs in at 212GB. Rockstar will sell a double-sided map/poster for 99 cents on its online store. It will also be included for free with purchases from the company's store, but fans can also download and print out a free one as well if they want.
paragraphs.cn: 众所周知，《GTA6》不会以光盘形式发售。Rockstar推出了一个「盒装兑换码」版本，目前已开始销售。因此，所有人都必须下载《GTA6》，游戏大小为212GB。Rockstar将在其在线商店以99美分的价格出售一张双面地图／海报。在该公司商店购买商品时也会免费附送，但粉丝如果愿意，也可以免费下载并打印一张。

paragraphs.en: While you wait for GTA 6 to unlock we've got loads of great coverage for you to check out, including Gangland Tales From the Frontline of Rockstar's Real-Life Grand Theft Auto Research , and How Gaming's Top Content Creators Are Preparing for GTA 6's Launch and Beyond .
paragraphs.cn: 在等待《GTA6》解锁期间，我们有大量精彩报道供你阅读，包括《Gangland Tales From the Frontline of Rockstar's Real-Life侠盗猎车手Research》和《How Gaming's Top Content Creators Are Preparing for GTA6's Launch and Beyond》。
